headline: HD Fire closes today — Retail 8x, GMP steady ~33%, apply via Retail; Tonbo, Zetwerk, Bonfiglioli, SMT open today with strong anchor books

hd-fire-protect.category_note: Closes today. GMP steady ₹83–91 (~33%). Retail 8x vs HNI ~31x, so Retail has the best odds; 1 lot per family PAN

fusion-cx.category_note: Day 2: Retail 1.09x, sNII 0.47x, so allotment is near-certain. GMP ₹33 (11%), up from ₹10; recheck on 16 Oct

tonbo-imaging.category_note: Opens today, no subscription yet. GMP ₹500 (71%), rising. Anchor book strong (₹255 Cr: SBI, ICICI Pru, HDFC, Goldman). Fundamentals weak (falling profit, 79x P/E), so apply only for a quick listing exit. Recheck on 19 Oct

zetwerk.category_note: Opens today, no subscription yet. GMP ₹22 (~15%). Anchor book strong (₹2,251 Cr incl. Smallcap World, SBI, ICICI Pru) but company is loss-making. Recheck on 19 Oct

bonfiglioli-transmissions.category_note: Opens today, no subscription yet. GMP ₹178 (30%). Anchor book strong (₹759 Cr, ~50 anchors). 100% OFS. Recheck on 19 Oct

sahajanand-medical-technologies.category_note: Opens today, no subscription yet. GMP ₹41 (12%), steady. Anchor book strong (₹140 Cr, mostly healthcare funds). Recheck on 19 Oct

paras-healthcare.category_note: Price band not announced; RHP not filed — analysis pending

notes: Subscription for the 15 Oct openers is not live yet at 09:07 IST.
Anchor allocations read from the NSE anchor letters (Bonfiglioli's is a scanned PDF, read manually; anchor count approximate).
